title: Subscription Billing
summary: Subscription billing turns plans and usage into correct invoices, month after month. It records who is on which plan, prorates mid-cycle changes, collects metered usage, generates invoices on each customer's renewal date, and charges the card on file. When a charge fails it retries on a schedule (dunning) before downgrading access, because a large share of churn is failed cards rather than unhappy customers.

walkthrough.title: Subscribe or change plan
walkthrough.text: A customer upgrades from Starter ($20/mo) to Pro ($50/mo) on day 10 of their billing cycle.

walkthrough.title: Price and prorate
walkthrough.text: The catalog provides Pro's price. The service credits the unused 20 days of Starter, charges 20 days of Pro, and records a new subscription version effective now.

walkthrough.title: Meter usage
walkthrough.text: The product reports usage events (API calls, seats, GB stored) with idempotency keys. They are aggregated per subscription and billing period.

walkthrough.title: Generate invoices
walkthrough.text: On each customer's renewal date the billing run builds an invoice: next month's Pro fee in advance, last month's metered usage in arrears, proration lines, discounts, and tax.

walkthrough.title: Charge the payment method
walkthrough.text: The invoice is finalised (immutable from now on) and charged to the saved card, using the invoice ID as idempotency key.

walkthrough.title: Dunning on failure
walkthrough.text: A declined charge enters dunning: retries at smart times (after payday, different hour), card-updater checks, and emails asking the customer to update their card.

walkthrough.title: Update entitlements
walkthrough.text: Payment webhooks drive access. Paid keeps Pro on. Still unpaid after the final retry moves the account to past-due, then downgraded or cancelled.

data.label: Customer & Product
responsibilities: Lets customers choose plans and manage billing themselves.
Gates features by the customer's current entitlements.
Shows clear invoices and upcoming charges.

failureModes.scenario: Entitlements read from billing on every request
failureModes.impact: A billing outage locks paying customers out.
failureModes.mitigation: Cache entitlements locally; billing problems must never block product access.
Preview proration before confirming; renewal reminder emails.

data.label: Subscription Service

input.name: Change
input.type: { customer, plan: pro, effective: now, prorate: true }

responsibilities: Owns each subscription's state, plan, quantity, and billing anchor date.
Computes proration for mid-cycle changes.
Accepts usage reports and routes them to metering.

failureModes.impact: Invoices off by cents; finance cannot reconcile.
failureModes.mitigation: Integer minor units, one documented rounding rule, golden tests.

failureModes.impact: Renewals on 31 Feb, or double billing at DST changes.
failureModes.mitigation: Store anchors in UTC; clamp to month end; property-based tests.

data.label: Plans & Price Catalog
responsibilities: Defines plans, tiers, per-unit prices, and currencies.
Versions prices so existing customers keep theirs (grandfathering).
Holds coupons and discounts with their rules.

failureModes.mitigation: Prices are immutable; a change means a new price version and an explicit migration.
Validation rules for coupon combinations; floor at zero.

data.label: Usage Metering

input.name: Usage events
input.type: { sub, metric: api_calls, qty: 1, ts, idempotencyKey }

responsibilities: Ingests high-volume usage events with deduplication.
Aggregates them by billing period, respecting late arrivals.
Gives customers a live view of usage so far.

failureModes.mitigation: Idempotency keys; reconcile against product-side counters.

failureModes.scenario: Events arrive after the invoice is final
failureModes.impact: Usage is lost or billed late.
failureModes.mitigation: A grace window before closing a period; bill late usage on the next invoice.

data.label: Invoicing Engine

output.name: Invoice
output.type: Line items + tax → finalised, numbered PDF

responsibilities: Builds invoices on each renewal date, spread out to avoid one giant month-start run.
Calculates tax by customer location.
Finalises invoices as immutable documents and posts them to the ledger.

failureModes.impact: Some customers billed twice or not at all.

failureModes.mitigation: Finalised invoices are immutable; corrections use credit notes.

data.label: Payment Processor

input.name: Charge
input.type: Invoice amount, payment method, idempotency key

responsibilities: Charges saved payment methods for recurring invoices.
Refreshes expired card numbers automatically via the card networks.
Reports outcomes and decline reasons.

failureModes.scenario: Retry after a timeout charges twice
failureModes.impact: Customer billed twice for one invoice.
failureModes.mitigation: Invoice ID as idempotency key on every charge attempt.
Card updater services plus pre-expiry reminders.

data.label: Dunning & Recovery

output.name: Plan
output.type: Retries over ~2-3 weeks, emails, final action

responsibilities: Retries failed charges at times most likely to succeed.
Treats soft declines (retry) differently from hard declines (ask for a new card).
Hands off to downgrade or cancel after the last attempt.

failureModes.impact: Processor fees and fraud flags on your account.
failureModes.mitigation: Never retry hard decline codes; request a new method instead.

failureModes.scenario: Customer updates card but no retry happens
failureModes.mitigation: Retry open invoices immediately on a card update.
